title: Requests
intro: Everything guests order from the app lands here the moment they tap it — work it, assign it, finish it.
readOnlyHint: Your subscription is read-only — renew to make changes.

noAccess.title: No access to requests
noAccess.hint: Your role doesn't include viewing guest requests. Ask a manager if you need access.

hint.title: A live board
hint.body: New requests appear on their own — no refreshing. Overdue cards float to the top, and a soft sound announces new arrivals (you can mute it with the speaker button).

empty.allClearHint: No open requests right now — new ones will appear here on their own.
empty.filteredHint: Try clearing a filter or two.
empty.historyHint: Completed and cancelled requests are kept here permanently.

sound.on: New-request sound is on — click to mute
sound.off: New-request sound is muted — click to enable

cancelForm.title: Why is this request being cancelled?
cancelForm.notePlaceholder: A short note about the reason (required for Other)
cancelForm.consequence: Cancelling is final — the guest will see the request as cancelled. This can't be undone.

assignForm.title: Assign to
assignForm.empty: No staff members can work requests yet — grant a role the "Work requests" permission first.

catalog.title: Request catalog
catalog.intro: What guests can order, in their own language — enable what your hotel offers, set time targets, and add your own items.
catalog.readOnlyHint: Your subscription is read-only — renew to make changes.

noAccess.title: No access to the catalog
noAccess.hint: Your role doesn't include managing the request catalog.

hint.title: Translated for you
hint.body: Built-in items are professionally translated into all seven guest languages — you only choose what's available and how fast it should be done. Custom items need Arabic and English; other languages are optional.

disableConfirm.title: Hide this item from guests?
disableConfirm.body: Guests won't be able to order it until you enable it again. Requests already submitted are not affected.

customItem.namesHelp: Guests who use another language will see the English name unless you add their language below.
customItem.slaHelp: How long this should take from request to done — the board turns amber near the target and red past it.
